check_status: Selected from the supplied catalog; not executed during read-only preparation.
scope_conditions: Use current_activity.py for the bounded activity projection and append-only update contract; preserve provider lifecycle authority.
Connect update recording to actual authorized consideration/action workflows, including the CLI or host handoff. An unused recording API does not satisfy acceptance.
Keep operational maintenance identities independent of work-item identities. Preserve existing incident resolution and recurrence semantics.
Place focused new recorder, projection, CLI-boundary and UI regression cases in the selected test modules so the catalog command exercises the changed behavior.
Document evidence precedence, freshness thresholds, recent-history window, ordering and update-recording responsibilities in the package README.
Do not change unrelated flow-metrics or analyst/SVG behavior, installed runtimes, external operational records or provider lifecycle files through this source scope.
Reconcile any necessary additional paths or check commands before expanding implementation.
required_gates: Coordinator scheduling and separate durable Ready -> Starting -> Running transitions before implementation; preserve active crisis restrictions and canonical execution identity.
Trace every canonical requirement and acceptance criterion to implemented behavior and evidence.
Deterministic active, waiting, failed, completed, stale, unknown and conflicting-evidence fixtures; separate recorded Running, observed execution and verified progress.
Verify meaningful-update selection, timestamp provenance, age calculations and refresh/progress separation; quiet execution must not imply termination.
Verify dependency, blocker, user-decision and exact-candidate approval action cues, including responsible actors where supported.
Verify resolved incidents disappear from current problems, retain history and require new evidence for recurrence.

Exercise append-only deferral, rejection, reconsideration, abandonment, implementation and considered-but-unchanged updates; retain rationale, evidence, next step and distinctions between expected benefit and verified outcome.
Verify category classification, recent-history window/order, canonical links, evidence links and maintenance entries without fabricated work items.
Verify the populated normal workflow with representative recorded provider, runtime, incident and decision evidence, including recording a substantive update and observing its projection.
Independent source review and independent desktop/narrow-screen usability review must accept the exact candidate, including keyboard access, readability, links and actionable information.
Record explicit approval bound to the exact reviewed and tested candidate before integration or deployment; a changed candidate requires renewed applicable evidence and approval.
Use deliver-work-item-main-branch: preserve unrelated checkout changes, prove candidate-to-integration mapping, run focused integrated checks and observe the accepted contribution on configured main.
If runtime activation or deployment is required, preserve its separate authority and clean-boundary activation requirements and verify the populated deployed result.
Only after Commit returns READY may the owning Orchestrator perform the separate file-provider terminal transaction and archive verification.
